lab.quote: On the PTCF front, the approval process is progressing in the desired direction, and we expect to commence commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

call_memory.quote: On the PTCF front, the approval process is progressing in the desired direction, and we expect to commence commercial sales in Q4 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The approval process for polyester tyre cord fabric (PTCF) is progressing in the desired direction, and commercial sales are expected to commence in Q4 FY27.

lab.quote: Our focus remains on mitigating external cost pressures through greater energy efficiency and operational optimization, while working towards a more sustainable cost structure over the coming quarters.

call_memory.quote: Our focus remains on mitigating external cost pressures through greater energy efficiency and operational optimization, while working towards a more sustainable cost structure over the coming quarters.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Additional hybrid power capacity at Bharuch is expected to start delivering cost benefits from Q4 FY27.

lab.quote: We expect on a very rough calculation basis, annualized benefit of about Rs. 10 crores per annum.

call_memory.quote: We expect on a very rough calculation basis, annualized benefit of about Rs. 10 crores per annum.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Additional hybrid power capacity is expected to generate an annualized benefit of about Rs. 10 crores per annum.

lab.quote: We normally maintain that our EBITDA should fluctuate between or should remain, depending on multiple factors, between 7% to 10% on a normalized basis.

call_memory.quote: We normally maintain that our EBITDA should fluctuate between or should remain, depending on multiple factors, between 7% to 10% on a normalized basis.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Normalized EBITDA margin is expected to fluctuate between 7% to 10% on a normalized basis.

lab.quote: And we expect it to touch maybe about 50% in the near term.

call_memory.quote: And we expect it to touch maybe about 50% in the near term.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Value-added products (VAPs) share in the yarn portfolio is expected to touch about 50% in the near term.

lab.quote: Our exports are, I mean, not large. It's about ranging between 4% to 5% of the turnover.

call_memory.quote: Our exports are, I mean, not large. It's about ranging between 4% to 5% of the turnover.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Exports range between 4% to 5% of the turnover.

lab.quote: We had about 85% capacity utilization in Q2 and as mentioned in the earlier question, the capacity utilization is a direct function of the demand and if the demand remains good, we should be closer to 90%.

call_memory.quote: We had about 85% capacity utilization in Q2 and as mentioned in the earlier question, the capacity utilization is a direct function of the demand and if the demand remains good, we should be closer to 90%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Capacity utilization in Q2 was about 85%.

lab.quote: For the 2nd Quarter of Financial Year 2027, revenue from operations grew 37% year-on-year to Rs. 558 crores... total volume for the quarter grew by 13% year-on-year to Rs. 20,162 metric tons.

call_memory.quote: For the 2nd Quarter of Financial Year 2027, revenue from operations grew 37% year-on-year to Rs. 558 crores... total volume for the quarter grew by 13% year-on-year to Rs. 20,162 metric tons.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total volume for Q2 FY27 grew by 13% year-on-year to 20,162 metric tons.

lab.quote: Total volume for the first half grew by 13% year-on-year to 39,361 metric tons.

call_memory.quote: Total volume for the first half grew by 13% year-on-year to 39,361 metric tons.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total volume for the first half of FY27 grew by 13% year-on-year to 39,361 metric tons.

lab.quote: However, the increase in imports impacted sales volume during the 2nd Quarter.

call_memory.quote: However, the increase in imports impacted sales volume during the 2nd Quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Increase in imports impacted sales volume during the 2nd Quarter for the tyre cord fabric segment.

call_points.text: Normalized EBITDA margin target reiterated at 7% to 10% despite Q2 pressure from rising raw material prices.
Value-added products expected to touch ~50% of nylon filament yarn revenue in the near term.
Exports currently account for 4% to 5% of overall turnover.
Management revised operating margin guidance upward to a range of 7% to 10% from the earlier 6% to 8% range.
Renewable power share of total consumption is expected to increase from 36% in FY26 to 48% after commissioning additional capacity in FY27.

operating_notes.text: PTCF approval process moved to next stage with regular commercial sales expected from FY27.
Renewable power share of total consumption is expected to increase to 48% in FY27 from 36% in FY26.
Polyester tire cord fabric capacity is 4 KT per annum, with commercial sales targeted for H2 FY27.
Approved as a participant under Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles in Technical Textile Segment (Part-2 Category).
Additional hybrid power capacity expected to deliver ~₹10 Cr annualized cost benefits starting Q4 FY27.
Caprolactam raw material prices fluctuated in the range of USD 2000 to USD 2100 per ton during Q2FY27.
Value-added products (VAPs) expected to reach ~50% of total yarn revenue in the near term.

timeline.summary: Century Enka credited 37.96 lakh shares of ABREL Century Energy to its demat account on 25th April 2026 to maintain its 26% captive power stake.
Century Enka received three GST enforcement notices for penalties aggregating to ₹17 lakh on April 28, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹483.53 Cr (+8.9% YoY), net profit ₹39.4 Cr (+482.8% YoY).
Century Enka released its Q4-FY26/FY26 investor presentation detailing financial performance and operational highlights.

Century Enka Limited’s **Rahul Dubey (VP Legal & Company Secretary)** uploaded the audio recording of its Q4-FY26/FY26 earnings conference call on 22 May 2026 at 2:00 PM (IST) via [www.centuryenka.com](https://www.centuryenka.com).
Century Enka held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, guiding to an improved operating margin of 7-10% and announcing a ₹100 Cr capex plan for FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹558.23 Cr (+36.6% YoY), net profit ₹18.49 Cr (-17.2% YoY).
Audio recording of Century Enka Limited's earnings conference call held 28 October 2026 uploaded to company website.
Received approval from Ministry of Textiles under PLI Scheme for Textiles in Technical Textile Segment (Part-2 Category).
Century Enka held its Q2FY27 earnings call, reiterating 7-10% EBITDA margin targets and expecting PTCF commercial sales in Q4FY27.
